intervals.label: far detector only
intervals.note: Start month from the collaboration's detector paper (far detector data taking began in April 2011); end is the start of data taking with the second detector, at the end of 2014.
intervals.quote: its data taking started first, in April 2011. After construction of the new near laboratory and detector, data taking with the second detector started at the end of 2014.

intervals.label: near and far detectors
intervals.note: Start and end from the collaboration's detector paper ('end of 2014', 'end of 2017'); both are approximate readings of 'end of' (December).
intervals.quote: After construction of the new near laboratory and detector, data taking with the second detector started at the end of 2014. Both detectors ran in parallel for about three years, until the end of 2017, when neutrino data taking was stopped.

intervals.label: shut down
intervals.note: Terminal event: end of neutrino data taking ('end of 2017' in the collaboration's detector paper), recorded approximately as December 2017.
intervals.quote: Both detectors ran in parallel for about three years, until the end of 2017, when neutrino data taking was stopped.

name: Double Chooz detectors
notes: Modelled as a single detector record covering both the near and far detectors, which the sources describe as (near-)identical designs.

placements.quote: located at 1050 m from the reactor cores of the Chooz nuclear power plant in France

placements.note: Near detector construction/commissioning finished substantially later than the far detector. The collaboration's detector paper says data taking with the second (near) detector started at the end of 2014, so the start is recorded as approximately December 2014.
placements.quote: After construction of the new near laboratory and detector, data taking with the second detector started at the end of 2014.

target_mass.note: Recorded as an approximate mass equivalent of the stated fiducial volume (Gd-loaded liquid scintillator, density close to 1 t/m³); the paper itself gives volume, not mass, directly.

summary.plain: Two similar tank-shaped detectors of gadolinium-loaded liquid scintillator, one close to and one far from the Chooz reactors, catching antineutrino flashes of light.
summary.technical: Gd-loaded liquid-scintillator detectors (four nested cylindrical liquid volumes: Gd-loaded target, Gd-free gamma catcher, buffer oil, scintillator veto), ~10.3 m³ fiducial volume, at near (400 m, from the end of 2014) and far (1050 m, from the 2012 result onward) halls at the Chooz reactor site.

technology.note: Structure as described in the collaboration's own detector paper; the 10.3 m³ target volume is the 2012 paper's '10.3 cubic meter fiducial volume' figure (see specs.target_mass).
technology.quote: a main detector comprising four cylindrical volumes filled with organic liquids. From the inside towards the outside there were volumes containing gadolinium-loaded scintillator, gadolinium-free scintillator, a buffer oil and, optically separated, another liquid scintillator acting as veto system.
technology.value: Liquid-scintillator detector whose main detector has four nested cylindrical volumes: a gadolinium-loaded scintillator target, a gadolinium-free scintillator gamma catcher, a buffer oil and an optically separated liquid-scintillator veto
